sources.name: Kraken Spot public market-data API
sources.notes: Canonical BTC/USD spot source candidate. Use the public Trades endpoint for actual trade timestamps and price; normalize Kraken's XBT symbol to BTC and retain raw pair/response. No credentials required for public market data.

sources.notes: Production provider to be selected and normalized before automated deployment.

sources.name: Farside Investors — Bitcoin ETF flows
sources.notes: Official Farside Investors all-data page for US spot BTC ETF flows. Confirmed accessible from the GitHub capture runner (HTTP 200) and linked from the official BTC landing page. Canonical source identity remains institutional.primary; row publication timestamp, finalization/revision semantics and exact parser reconciliation still require review. The /btc/ landing URL remains accepted for existing historical provenance. Do not infer observed_at from retrieval time.

sources.name: TFTC Bitcoin ETF Flows — public JSON candidate
sources.notes: Candidate public mirror of US spot BTC ETF daily flows. Landing page advertises a JSON data endpoint and CC BY 4.0 reuse; verify schema, exact source lineage, dates and revisions before canonical ingestion. Not yet in metric source_priority.

sources.name: OKX V5 Market API
sources.notes: Independent BTC-USDT spot-trade cross-check candidate. Preserve the USDT/BTC unit and source trade timestamp; USDT is not USD. Not approved as canonical market.spot_price source, and must not be blended into Kraken XBT/USD.

sources.name: ICE U.S. Dollar Index (DXY) — source candidate
sources.access_method: ICE Data API / ICE Connect / licensed data delivery; access unconfirmed
sources.notes: ICE is the administrator of DXY and documents intraday and daily products delivered through ICE Connect, ICE Data API, ICE Consolidated Feed/History and data files. The cited URL is product documentation, not a public quote endpoint. Access, license/redistribution terms, actual project-accessible feed, response schema, daily-close field and source timestamp semantics are unverified. Candidate only; not in macro.dxy source_priority and must fail readiness. Required candidate convention: store the actual source timestamp of the last DXY index level disseminated for that ICE index business day as observed_at; retain the index business date separately as period_start; store retrieval time independently as retrieved_at. Do not infer a timestamp from the retrieval time or from the date label.

sources.name: SoSoValue ETF Summary History — public API candidate
sources.notes: Official API candidate: GET https://openapi.sosovalue.com/openapi/v1/etfs/summary-history?symbol=BTC&country_code=US (date-range/limit parameters documented). Returns daily aggregate total_net_inflow in USD and trading date only; supports only the most recent month and excludes non-trading days. API key required. Documentation does not establish an exact publication timestamp or revision/finalization guarantee. Candidate only; not in institutional.etf_net_flow source_priority and not allowed by readiness until access, response schema, timestamp semantics, revision policy and reconciliation are verified.

sources.name: Yahoo Finance DXY chart — access-restricted candidate
sources.access_method: Yahoo Finance website / undocumented chart endpoint; automated capture disabled
sources.notes: Ticker DX-Y.NYB is the U.S. Dollar Index (DXY), shown as an ICE Futures instrument. The chart endpoint is undocumented and is not an approved public API. Yahoo's general Terms of Service prohibit automated data collection without express prior permission. Daily Close must be distinguished from Adj Close and intraday price. Provider timestamp is a candle/session label, not proven actual close or publication time. Session date must use provider exchange timezone and be stored separately. No macro.dxy source_priority approval; no canonical ingestion until access/reuse permission, exact close timestamp semantics, and freshness rule are verified.

sources.name: CryptoETF.today — US spot Bitcoin ETF flow tracker
sources.notes: Aggregate and per-fund ETF flow cross-check candidate. Do not treat aggregate agreement as proof of complete per-fund rows; verify session date, row completeness, units, retrieval timestamp and revision semantics. Never canonical or production-approved by catalog inclusion.

sources.name: CoinPulseHQ — Bitcoin ETF flow tracker
sources.notes: Independent public tracker candidate for per-fund US spot BTC ETF flows. Research cross-check only; verify exact session, fund coverage, units, source lineage and revision/finality before use.

sources.name: Bitcoin Almanack — Bitcoin ETF flow tracker
sources.notes: Session-validation/status cross-check. Not a primary per-fund flow source; tracker may label the latest session preliminary/unfinalized. Preserve its stated status and do not infer missing values.

sources.name: BitTradeScanner — Bitcoin ETF flow tracker
sources.notes: Auxiliary flow cross-check only. Observed tracker data can be incomplete and materially disagree with Farside; never substitute its aggregate silently or fill missing funds without row-level evidence.

sources.name: Bitbo — Bitcoin ETF holdings tracker
sources.notes: BTC holdings change cross-check candidate. Holdings are a separate metric from USD flows; preserve fund ticker, BTC units, observation/session date, retrieval time and provider/source lineage. Not approved for canonical ingestion.

sources.name: BitcoinTreasuries.net — Bitcoin ETF holdings tracker
sources.notes: ETF/fund holdings cross-check candidate. Verify the exact fund, BTC units, date and underlying issuer evidence. Holdings do not substitute for daily USD net flows; not approved for canonical ingestion.
